items.item: High-confidence band arithmetic
items.detail: The brief asks for picks at ≥70% probability AND inside −250…+10,000. 70% is −233 and −250 is 71.43%, so both can only hold for probabilities in 70.00–71.43%. High picks on this desk are selected inside that band; every other row is graded Medium/Low. If the intended floor was −250 with no probability floor, say so and the grading rule can be relaxed to p ≥ 55% for the window.

items.item: NBA fixture feed blocked
items.detail: cdn.nba.com returned HTTP 403 for both schedule endpoints and data.nba.com returned a redirect shell, so no NBA fixture could be verified from an official feed. No NBA row, price or prediction is published.

items.item: Rugby Union: URC feed unavailable
items.detail: unitedrugby.com returned HTTP 404 on /fixtures-and-results, /standings, /fixtures and /match-centre; premiershiprugby.com renders fixtures client-side. Only the two Top 14 fixtures on top14.lnr.fr could be verified, so Rugby Union has 2 picks, not 5.

items.item: Darts has no machine-readable official fixture page
items.detail: pdc.tv returned the same 1,241,860-byte shell for six different URLs, so no darts fixture, start time or entry list could be read from the governing body's own site. The OLBG darts listings seen in this capture are published on the OLBG page but carry no price. Snooker, by contrast, is served as static HTML and JSON by snooker.org, so its semi-final is verified and listed.

items.item: Cricket has verified fixtures but no strength input
items.detail: Cricket Australia's official feed supplied 14 upcoming fixtures with start times, but the ICC team-ranking endpoints returned 404, so no team strength could be read from an official page. The fixtures are listed on Matches with no line and no pick.

items.item: Golf, Gaelic, Greyhounds, Motor Racing, Rugby League not priced
items.detail: Each sport's official fixture/strength feed was client-side rendered or returned an error in this capture (details on Coverage). Handball was in this list until the Danish Herreligaen programme page was read row-by-row: it is server-rendered, carries every round with its score and the published local throw-off, and now supplies eight priced fixtures. Nothing is estimated to fill a gap.

items.item: MLB start times are stored as 00:00Z
items.detail: The MLB Stats API returns World Series games with gameDate 2026-10-25T00:00:00Z, which is the US evening of 24 October in UTC terms. Kick-off times for baseball rows should be read as the API value, which is the official field, not as a local first-pitch clock.

items.item: No official injury feed captured
items.detail: No roster/injury endpoint was part of this capture, so predictions make no injury claim. Where an official feed does name a probable pitcher (MLB) it is quoted; otherwise the text says nothing rather than guessing.

items.item: Desk cap: 24 priced fixtures per sport
items.detail: Ice Hockey has 85 verified fixtures in the window and Basketball 20, so the desk prices the earliest 24 per sport and lists the rest on Matches with no line. The cap keeps the rebuild deterministic and the page size readable; it is a desk choice, not a data limit.

items.item: Coverage is 9 of 15 sports with fixtures and 7 with own lines
items.detail: Ice Hockey, Basketball, Baseball, Tennis, Volleyball, Handball and Rugby Union carry own lines; Cricket and Snooker are fixtures only, and the other six sports are listed on Coverage with the exact reason. Five written predictions exist per priced sport except Rugby Union, which has only two fixtures in the window.

items.item: Boards FB/EZ/BN grade their top five rows per sport as 'High' from a composite index, not from the brief's ≥70…
items.detail: Boards FB/EZ/BN grade their top five rows per sport as 'High' from a composite index, not from the brief's ≥70% probability test; published examples sit at 55–69% (e.g. FB-PRED-01 is p=0.5942, −146). Their High labels are therefore not comparable with the High labels on this desk, which enforce ≥70% and the −250…+10,000 window together.
